CustomField.description: Lifecycle status of the contact. Used by lookup filters to exclude stale contacts from selection lists. Aligned with UAT feedback C-06.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Active = currently engaged. Inactive = no longer at company or disengaged. Departed = confirmed left the organisation. Inactive and Departed contacts are excluded from lookup filters on BAN Billing Contact and Opportunity Contact Roles.
CustomField.label: Contact Status
